design_gotchas.title: 17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Buses Built for Pin-Identical TPS54302DDCR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS563201DDCR has the exact same SOT-23-6 pinout as TPS54302DDCR (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=VFB, 5=EN, 6=VBST) and AP62200WU-7, but its 17 V max input (19 V abs max) and 7.0 V max output cannot survive 24 V industrial rails. Only use on <= 12 V / 15 V buses.

design_gotchas.title: Floating EN Disables TPS563201 (Internal 1.5 MOhm Pulldown) — Opposite of TPS54302 & AP62200
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike TPS54302DDCR and AP62200WU-7 (which float EN to auto-enable), TPS563201 has an internal 1.5 MOhm pulldown on EN so leaving Pin 5 floating keeps the regulator permanently OFF. Conversely, TPS563201 allows tying EN directly to VIN (up to 19 V abs max).

design_gotchas.title: VFB = 0.768 V Causes +29% Overvoltage If Dropped Into a TPS54302 (0.596 V) Divider
design_gotchas.detail: Substituting TPS563201DDCR (0.768 V VFB) onto a board with feedback resistors sized for TPS54302DDCR (0.596 V VFB) increases VOUT by +28.9% (e.g., 3.3 V jumps to 4.25 V), risking immediate downstream IC damage. Always recalculate feedback resistors.

design_gotchas.title: Pinout Mismatch vs AP63203WU-7 and D-CAP2 Output Capacitance Limit (20-68 uF)
design_gotchas.detail: AP63203WU-7 uses a completely different 6-pin layout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) and is not pin-compatible. Also respect D-CAP2 ceramic Cout bounds (20-68 uF per Table 7-2) and 1.0 ms internal soft-start.

typical_use_cases: 12 V adapter or 5 V/12 V bus step-down to 0.9 V, 1.2 V, 1.8 V, 3.3 V, or 5.0 V at up to 3 A
Cost-optimized D-CAP2 fast-transient point-of-load rail for digital TVs, routers, set-top boxes, and SBCs
High-frequency (580 kHz) compact SOT-23-6 buck using small 2.2-3.3 uH inductors and ceramic capacitors
engineering_summary: The TPS563201DDCR is a 4.5 V to 17 V input, 3 A continuous synchronous buck converter in SOT-23-6 (DDC) using TI's D-CAP2 adaptive on-time control with Eco-mode light-load operation (580 kHz typ, 120 uA Iq, ~94% peak efficiency, 2.2-3.3 uH inductor). While pin-compatible with TPS54302DDCR and AP62200WU-7, engineers must account for its 17 V input cap, 7.0 V output cap, 0.768 V feedback reference, and internal EN pulldown (must be pulled high to start, unlike float-to-enable peers). Always verify divider ratios and input transients against the official TI datasheet before production.
